svg.title: Truck–robot logistics — integrated urban express routing
svg.desc: Adapted from the author's original routing figure. The two truck circuits retain their original stop positions: LT1 visits O, G, H, I, J, O; LT2 visits O, A, B, C, D, E, F, O. Muted local robot routes and order marks are vector traces from the original figure; they are not generated connections.
svg.text: Integrated routing of trucks and robots
